run.visibility_definition: all stations simultaneously have elevation >= min_elevation_deg

coordinate_frame.name: ITRS
coordinate_frame.description: ITRS (International Terrestrial Reference System) Earth-centred, Earth-fixed Cartesian coordinates as implemented by Skyfield (skyfield.framelib.itrs; TEME->ITRS via SGP4/Skyfield; polar motion neglected). Station positions from WGS84 geodetic coordinates.
